messages:
Zoe K: Morning! small idea
Zoe K: Weekend micro-challenge: sunrise yoga + stair sprints Saturday. 20min yoga at 6:30am on the plaza, then 6x up-down stairs at the old amphitheater. low-key, scalable. who9s in? :sunrise_over_mountains::muscle:
Ben P: I'm intrigued. yoga first then sprints sounds brutal but fun. count me in if its 6:30 exactly.
Hannah R: I can do yoga but will skip sprints  knee day. Can I tag someone for a modified stair walk?
Eli N: Modified track OK. I'll time the sprints and do a little printable leaderboard. nothing public.
Zoe K: great. plan: meet 6:25 for mats, 6:30 start. yoga ~20min, 6:55 quick water, 7:00 stairs for ~15min. wrap by 7:20.
Ben P: tagging calendar-bot to reserve plaza: @calendar-bot add event "Sat Sunrise Yoga + Stairs" 2026-06-06 06:25 -> 07:25
calendar-bot: Event created: "Sat Sunrise Yoga + Stairs"  invites sent to Zoe K, Ben P, Hannah R, Eli N
Hannah R: thanks! I'll bring a small foam wedge for my knee. :pill:
Eli N: I'll bring a cheap stopwatch and a tiny whiteboard for times. also can toss in a warm cocoa thermos for after if folks want. :hot_beverage:
Ben P: quick poll for music: ambient playlist or upbeat? react :notes: for ambient, :fire: for upbeat
Zoe K: :notes:
Eli N: :fire:
Hannah R: :notes:
fit-bot: Reminder: warm up for 5 minutes before stair sprints. Suggested drills: ankle mobility, light jog, 3x 20s strides.
Zoe K: perfect. see you Saturday sunrise crew. low-pressure, bring layers. :seedling:
